content.title: Search for homes from the homepage
content.description: A guest starts on the airbnb.co.in homepage, enters a destination in the Where field, optionally supplies valid check-in and check-out dates plus guest counts, clicks Search, and lands on the Homes results page with the submitted parameters preserved; the flow explicitly supports both a complete search with destination, dates, and guests and a partial search with destination and guests only, so the guest can begin browsing even before choosing dates.
content.summary: Start a Homes search from the homepage with inputs preserved.
content.value: Gets the guest from homepage intent capture into browseable Homes results without losing search context.
criteria: Homepage search uses the fields Where, Check-in, Check-out, and Who.
Homepage search accepts typed destinations (city/region), optional dates, and guest counts.
Clicking Search opens the Homes results page.
Applied parameters are visible in the results header.
The complete-input flow supports destination plus valid check-in/check-out dates and guests.
The partial-input flow supports destination and guests without dates.
The homepage and results journey keeps the labels Where, Check-in, Check-out, and Who.
The call to action remains Search in the defined localization.

content.title: Refine home search results
content.description: A guest who has reached the Homes results page can continue narrowing the current search using the existing Filters and Map controls, with results updating after filter application and listings displayed on the map so the guest can refine by both property attributes and location without restarting the search.
content.summary: Refine Homes results with filters and map.
content.value: Helps the guest narrow broad search results into relevant options faster.
criteria: Results refinement uses the existing Filters and Map controls exposed on the results page.
Guests can refine using the standard Airbnb filters documented in Help.
The map view displays listings for the current search.
This story does not introduce new filter types or reorder existing filters.

content.title: Edit a home search from the results page
content.description: A guest on the Homes results page can see the current destination, dates, and guest parameters in the header, click into those controls to change them, refresh the results without returning to the homepage, and—when the search was started without dates—add dates directly on the results page later instead of restarting the journey.
content.summary: Change search inputs directly from results.
content.value: Lets the guest iterate on a search in place instead of backtracking to the homepage.
criteria: Entered search inputs remain visible and editable directly on the results page so the guest does not need the browser back button to adjust the query.
Applied parameters are visible in the results header.
From the results header, the guest can edit destination, dates, or guests.
After editing parameters on the results page, the guest can refresh results without navigating back to the homepage.
If the search started without dates, the guest can add dates later directly on the results page.
